name: Pan-Seared Snapper or Sea Bass (Plain Mod · Plaza de Coco)
whyItWorks: Flaky red snapper and sea bass are ultra-gentle proteins; pairing them with smooth refried beans and white rice makes a flare-safe Mexican dinner.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the snapper or sea bass seared plain (no adobo spice or chimichurri/pico de gallo) and served with plain white rice, peeled rainbow carrots, and a small side of smooth refried pinto beans.
watchOuts: Default adobo spice rub and herb chimichurri
Raw tomato pico de gallo and lime squeeze
